meta.title: Linux Computer Use
meta.description: Drive the local Linux graphical desktop: screenshots, clicks, drags, scrolling, keyboard input and window listing/activation, application listing/launch/focus, display enumeration, window move and resize, UI state assertions, plus optional AT-SPI accessibility-tree reading and control-value writing, and browser control that runs on the AT-SPI accessibility tree + XTEST (no CDP). Works on native X11 sessions with XTEST (XFCE, GNOME, KDE, any X11 desktop; not on native Wayland sessions). Requires xdotool, scrot, ffmpeg and wmctrl plus a DISPLAY/XAUTHORITY owned by the same user; the accessibility tree additionally needs at-spi2-core, libatk-adaptor and python3-gi; the browser tools need chromium or google-chrome. Write actions require a fresh screenshot and pass a graded approval. ⚠️ Risk: an AI agent holds real mouse and keyboard control — a mistake can delete files, overwrite documents, leak credentials, send messages or trigger payments. Run it inside a sandbox or isolated desktop.
